factionRules.name: Forward Scouting
factionRules.text: Select and resolve up to six Forward Scouting options. Each option’s limit is shown below. If both players have this rule, alternate resolving selections, starting with the player with initiative.

factionRules.name: Redeploy (maximum 1)
factionRules.text: Change the set up of one third of your operatives, rounding up.

factionRules.name: Reposition (maximum 2)
factionRules.text: Perform a free Reposition action with one friendly operative wholly within your drop zone. It must end wholly within 3" of your drop zone.

factionRules.name: Trip Alarm (maximum 2)
factionRules.timing: Forward Scouting; remove in the Ready step of Turning Point 3
factionRules.text: Place a Trip Alarm marker more than 6" from the opponent’s drop zone. During Turning Points 1 and 2, friendly Scout Squad ranged weapons have Seek when shooting an enemy within 2" of it. Remove it in the Ready step of the third Strategy phase.

factionRules.name: Booby Trap (maximum 1)
factionRules.timing: Forward Scouting; first enemy enters its control range
factionRules.text: Place a Booby Trap marker more than 6" from the opponent’s drop zone and more than 2" from other markers, access points and Accessible terrain. The first time it is within enemy control range, remove it, inflict 2D3 damage, and end the operative’s action if it survives. If it cannot be placed, move it the minimum amount to do so. Record wounds or elimination in the NPO Roster.

factionRules.name: Designate Target (maximum 1)
factionRules.timing: Forward Scouting and attacks against the designated target
factionRules.text: Give one enemy operative a Target token. When a friendly Scout Squad operative shoots, fights, or retaliates against it, you can re-roll one attack die.

factionRules.name: Spy (maximum 1)
factionRules.text: The opponent must reveal their selected tac op.

strategicGambits.name: Tactical Manoeuvre
strategicGambits.text: Twice per battle, select one friendly operative. Until the end of its next activation, add 1 to its APL stat.

strategicGambits.name: Diversion
strategicGambits.text: Once per battle, select one enemy operative within 6" of a killzone edge. Until the end of its next activation, subtract 1 from its APL stat.

abilities.name: Guidance and Experience
abilities.text: Once during each activation, select one other friendly Scout Squad operative in the killzone. Until the end of that operative’s next activation, add 1 to its APL stat.

abilities.name: Astartes
abilities.text: During this operative’s activation, it can perform either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. If it performs two Shoot actions, an Astartes shotgun, bolt pistol or boltgun must be selected for at least one of them. It can counteract regardless of its order.

abilities.name: Heavy Weapon Bipod
abilities.text: Whenever this operative is shooting with a datacard weapon, if it has not moved during the activation or is counteracting, that weapon has Ceaseless; if it already has Ceaseless, it has Relentless instead. This does not prevent movement after shooting.

weapons.name: Heavy bolter (sweeping)
weapons.manualResolution: Resolve Blast or Torrent against all eligible targets on the tabletop. Record wounds or elimination for every affected operative in the Player or NPO Roster, then resume the activation.

abilities.name: Heavy Weapon Bipod
abilities.text: Whenever this operative is shooting with a datacard weapon, if it has not moved during the activation or is counteracting, that weapon has Ceaseless; if it already has Ceaseless, it has Relentless instead. This does not prevent movement after shooting.

weapons.name: Missile launcher (frag)
weapons.manualResolution: Resolve Blast or Torrent against all eligible targets on the tabletop. Record wounds or elimination for every affected operative in the Player or NPO Roster, then resume the activation.

abilities.name: Grapnel Launcher
abilities.text: Whenever this operative is climbing up, treat the vertical distance as 2" regardless of the actual vertical movement.

abilities.name: Grapnel Assault
abilities.text: After this operative performs Charge during its activation, if it climbed, dropped, jumped, or its base moved underneath Vantage terrain during that action, its melee weapons have Lethal 3+ until the end of that activation.

abilities.name: Camo Cloak
abilities.text: When an operative shoots this operative, ignore Saturate. If any cover saves can be retained, retain one additional cover save or one cover save as a critical success instead; this is not cumulative with improved cover saves from Vantage terrain.

abilities.name: Optics (1AP)
abilities.text: Until the start of this operative’s next activation, enemy operatives cannot be obscured when it shoots. It cannot perform this action within enemy control range.

abilities.name: Track Enemy (1AP)
abilities.text: Select one enemy operative within 8". Until the end of the turning point, friendly Scout Squad operatives’ ranged weapons have Seek Light when shooting it. This action cannot be performed within enemy control range.

abilities.name: Auspex Scan (1AP)
abilities.text: Until the start of this operative’s next activation or until it is incapacitated, when a friendly Scout Squad operative shoots an enemy within 8" of this operative, that enemy cannot be obscured. If the shooter is a Sniper benefiting from Optics, its ranged weapons also have Seek Light. This action cannot be performed within enemy control range.

abilities.name: Adaptive Equipment
abilities.text: Once per turning point each, one friendly Scout Squad Warrior can perform Smoke Grenade and one can perform Stun Grenade. Uses granted by this rule do not count toward those universal equipment action limits.
